steps: Onboarding saves step and closes for later without fake artists
Taste selects an actual owned-catalogue artist and persists
Explicit skip completes onboarding with zero selected artists
Artist page resolves catalogue tracks through the real artist API
Real friend request and acceptance updates both accounts
Hosted jam accepts only a real friend and stays out of public rooms
Publication with private uploaded audio is rejected and keeps the editor open
Public playlist discovery loads actual published playlists and an honest empty track list
Three themes retain readable privacy controls on desktop and phone
All six languages render translated product labels
Global font and 125 percent scale fit a phone with all header controls visible
Notifications expire after their actual 6.5 second timer
Email change shows confirmation after a real server acknowledgement
Profile listening totals come from actual server statistics
Actual account deletion requires password and exact username and clears private local state after server success
